abdomialPain <- read.csv("AbdominalPain.csv", header = TRUE, colClasses = "factor")
head(abdomialPain)
##   No. Age Sex Duration N.V Anorexia Defecation           Site Fever
## 1   1  83   M        3  No       No        Yes            RUQ    No
## 2   2  63   M        7 Yes      Yes        Yes     Generlized    No
## 3   3  80   F        2 Yes       No        Yes            RUQ    No
## 4   4  86   F        3 Yes       No        Yes RUQ-Epigastric   Yes
## 5   5  44   F        1 Yes      Yes        Yes RUQ-Epigastric    No
## 6   6  72   M        2  No       No        Yes            RUQ    No
##   Past.Surgery Tenderness Amylase   WBC   HB    Plt Neu AST ALT ALK.P SBP
## 1           No        Yes      36 17800 14.9 112000  85  22  23   324 100
## 2          Yes         No      41  7600 15.6 226000  88  23  17   164 120
## 3           No        Yes      37  7000 13.3 163000  87 142 224   639 130
## 4           No        Yes      33 16600 12.7 166000  92 249 139   469 115
## 5           No         No     792  7900 13.9 213000  70 228 275   323 140
## 6          Yes        Yes      58 10600 11.9 217000  81  71  27   232 120
##           Cause
## 1 Cholecystitis
## 2            BO
## 3 Cholecystitis
## 4 Cholecystitis
## 5  Pancreatitis
## 6 Cholecystitis
dim(abdomialPain)
## [1] 534  21
abdomialPain <- na.omit(abdomialPain) 
# Select specific columns using subset
selected_data <- subset(abdomialPain, select = c(Duration, N.V, Anorexia, 
                                                 Site, Fever, Past.Surgery, Tenderness, Cause))

# View the selected data
head(selected_data)
##   Duration N.V Anorexia           Site Fever Past.Surgery Tenderness
## 1        3  No       No            RUQ    No           No        Yes
## 2        7 Yes      Yes     Generlized    No          Yes         No
## 3        2 Yes       No            RUQ    No           No        Yes
## 4        3 Yes       No RUQ-Epigastric   Yes           No        Yes
## 5        1 Yes      Yes RUQ-Epigastric    No           No         No
## 6        2  No       No            RUQ    No          Yes        Yes
##           Cause
## 1 Cholecystitis
## 2            BO
## 3 Cholecystitis
## 4 Cholecystitis
## 5  Pancreatitis
## 6 Cholecystitis
dim(selected_data)
## [1] 534   8
boxplot(selected_data$Duration)

site_values <- levels(selected_data$Site)
print(site_values)
##  [1] "Epigastric"        "Generlized"        "Hypogastric"      
##  [4] "LLQ"               "LUQ"               "Periumbelical"    
##  [7] "RLQ"               "RLQ-Epigastric"    "RLQ-Periumbelical"
## [10] "RUQ"               "RUQ-Epigastric"    "RUQ-Periumbelical"
cause_values <- levels(selected_data$Cause)
print(cause_values)
##  [1] "Appendicitis"           "Biliary Colic"          "BO"                    
##  [4] "CBD"                    "Cholangitis"            "Cholecystitis"         
##  [7] "Esophageal Perforation" "GYN"                    "Hernia"                
## [10] "Invagination"           "Multiple Pathology"     "NOS"                   
## [13] "Pancreatitis"           "Peritonitis"            "PUD Perforated"        
## [16] "Thrombotic"

LLQ: left lower quadrant LUQ: left upper quadrant RLQ: right lower quadrant RUQ: right upper quadrant

BO: bowel obstruction CBD: cannadibiol GYN: Gynecology or Gynecological issues NOS: not otherwise specified PUD Perforated: peptic ulcer disease perforated

library(dplyr)
## 
## Attaching package: 'dplyr'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter, lag
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
# Modify multiple values using mutate and case_when
selected_data <- selected_data %>%
  mutate(Site = case_when(
    Site == "RLQ-Epigastric" ~ "RLQ",
    Site == "RUQ-Epigastric" ~ "RUQ",
    Site == "RLQ-Periumbelical" ~ "RLQ",
    Site == "RUQ-Periumbelical" ~ "RUQ",
    TRUE ~ Site  # Keep other values the same
  ))

# View the modified data
print(selected_data)

selected_data <- selected_data %>%
  mutate(Site = case_when(
    Site == "Generlized" ~ "Generalized or Others",
    Site == "Periumbelical" ~ "Generalized or Others",
    Site == "Hypogastric" ~ "Generalized or Others",
    Site == "LUQ" ~ "Generalized or Others",
    Site == "LLQ" ~ "Generalized or Others",
    TRUE ~ Site  # Keep other values the same
  ))
unique(selected_data$Site)

## [4] "RLQ"
# Modify multiple values using mutate and case_when
selected_data <- selected_data %>%
  mutate(Cause = case_when(
    Cause == "Biliary Colic" ~ "Bile Pancreas",

selected_data$Duration <- as.numeric(as.character(selected_data$Duration))

                      labels = c("0-3", "3-7"), # Group labels
                      right = TRUE,  # Right-closed intervals (e.g., 3 goes to the first group)
                      include.lowest = TRUE)  # Include the lowest value in the first group

##           from       to     strength
## 1     Anorexia    Cause 9.517296e-01
## 2 Past.Surgery    Cause 1.417573e-01
## 3   Tenderness    Cause 5.186545e-01
## 4         Site    Cause 2.876560e-71
## 5          N.V Anorexia 4.106372e-03

score(dag, data = selected_data, type = "bic")
## [1] -3388.865
graphviz.plot(dag)

bn.fit.barchart(bn$Cause, main = "Cause", xlab = "Pr(Cause|Anorexia, Site, Past.Surgery, Tenderness)", ylab ="")

bn.fit.barchart(bn.mle$Cause, main = "Cause", xlab = "Pr(Cause|Anorexia, Site, Past.Surgery, Tenderness)", ylab ="")

bn.fit.barchart(bn.bayes$Cause, main = "Cause", xlab = "Pr(Cause|Anorexia, Site, Past.Surgery, Tenderness)", ylab ="")

graphviz.chart(bn, grid = TRUE, main = "Prior BN")

graphviz.chart(bn.mle, grid = TRUE, main = "MLE BN")

library(gRain)
junction <- compile(as.grain(bn.bayes))
querygrain(junction, nodes = "Cause")$Cause

j_predict <- setEvidence(junction, 
                         nodes = c("Duration", "N.V", "Anorexia", "Site", "Fever", "Past.Surgery", "Tenderness"), 
                         states = c("0-3", "Yes", "Yes", "RLQ", "Yes", "No", "Yes"))
querygrain(j_predict, nodes = "Cause")$Cause
